1.

Lord Jesus, Thee we honour, Exalted on Thy Father’s throne, The heart’s homage to Thee we bear, God’s only begotten, precious Son. Thee we praise, Thee we worship, Laud Thee in united tone, (united tone) Laud Thee in united tone.

2.

Lord of life! Unto death obedient Here, Thy cross Thou didst bear, Thou, who to Thy Father’s heart Wast a perfect joy. Thee we revere, Thee we remember, Thou, who wast the Offering Lamb, (Offering Lamb) Thou, who wast the Offering Lamb.

3.

Anointed King, crowned with glory, Lord of glory, Thou, Once smitten and despised, Now richly rewarded by the Father, Thee we behold And admire, Thou joy of heaven’s spring! (Heaven’s joy) Thou joy of heaven’s spring!

4.

Royal robe shall soon adorn Thee, Soon Thou shalt the diadem wear. Thou God’s Anointed, the heart’s obedience Gratefully we give Thee here; Thee we adore, Thee we hymn, Lord Christ, where Thou art, (where Thou art) Lord Christ, where Thou art.
